scope: Post-observation authored development diagnosis and regression evidence. The formal workload, queries, gold, scorer, protocol and all prior failures remain unchanged. This is not an independent holdout or an external-repository superiority experiment.

source_components.A: Whole authenticated source must contain only repeated independently qualifying declarations of the identical literal and exact local scope; extra literal mentions retain ambiguity. Qualified-name segments remain distinct.
source_components.B: Finite reporting-description and Chinese declaration frames preserve discovered field aliases and literal query names. Unicode quotation/name guards reject new interpretation without changing the historical quote parser.
source_components.C: The added reference-report route requires an authenticated complete source whose every line fits a closed explicit no-change/report grammar. It may lend its relevance slot only to a same-chapter, same-field, same-scope declaration with no loss of query coverage. Queried report actions/objects or independent check objects retain their own sources. Extra named fields require whole-identity query coverage; shared aliases do not suffice. The existing agenda route remains separately guarded.
